content: We need number of CH3 groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the sample is implicit? We need to get NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. Could use proton NMR to count methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (requires SMILES). But we don't have SMILES. Maybe the system expects we can retrieve NMR spectra for the sample at hand (unknown). The tool carbon_nmr_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra, hsqc_nmr_spectra have no parameters. They just measure the sample at hand. So we can call proton_nmr_spectra to get 1H NMR. Then count methyl peaks (singlet, doublet, etc). Let's do that.
